title: In JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA before 2026.3 untrusted projects could read files of other open projects via the built-in…
description: A vulnerability in JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA versions before 2026.3 allows untrusted projects to read files from other open projects via the built-in web server. This issue could lead to unauthorized disclosure of sensitive information across projects within the same IDE session.
